text:
People Ops: Heads-up: we've opened a 4-day compliance sprint to wrap up outstanding SOC2/ISO evidence and annual privacy attestations. Please treat this as high priority if you're listed on an access roster or own a control. Deadline = Sunday 11:59pm PT. :alarm_clock:

People Ops: Actions (fast):
1) Finish the new 10-min "Data & Secrets" micro-module (link below)
2) Upload evidence or an "in-progress" placeholder for each control you own
3) Managers: confirm your team's items in the verification flow
Office hours: Thu/Fri 09:00-12:00 PT in #help (drop-in)

People Ops: Links -> training: https://internal.redwood/training/data-secrets-2026  evidence form: https://internal.redwood/forms/evidence-upload  manifest: https://drive.redwood.com/compliance/manifest

Riley K.: Quick Q: does the sprint include infra-only roles (no customer data) that still have prod creds?

Omar - Security: Yes. Any identity with prod keys or deploy rights should at least complete the module and indicate whether secrets are rotated monthly. If you rotate quarterly, mark as BLOCKED and include owner + ETA.

Tara (Eng): For logs where retention is pending, can I upload a retention-policy doc as interim evidence?

People Ops: Yep. Upload the policy PDF + a note with expected export date. Use subject prefix SPRINT-<control_id> in the form so reviewers can auto-match. Example: SPRINT-4a-logs - placeholder - #ticket

contractor-josh: Attested. Uploaded placeholder for CC-5 (audit trail). Ticket #4122. Thanks for the office hours today.

Riley K.: I put placeholders for 3 items and added the ticket links. Marked two as BLOCKED because they rely on a vendor response.

People Ops: Good call. Put "BLOCKED: vendor response" in the notes and include the expected vendor ETA. We'll escalate vendor-blocked items if not cleared by Monday.

Omar - Security: Reminder: naming for S3 exports -> redwood_prod_logs_YYYYMMDD_<team>.zip. If you uploaded with a different name, please update the artifact link. We use that convention for automated ingestion.

Riley K.: Updating now. Also tagging manager for verification.

People Ops: Managers: after your team uploads, run the manager verify flow in the evidence form. You should see the "Manager verification" checkbox at the end. This helps Legal reconcile before the monthly compliance bundle.

compliance-bot: Automated reminder scheduled -> 36 hours left until Sunday 11:59pm PT. Items still marked incomplete: 27.

Tara (Eng): FYI I uploaded a console snapshot + scheduled export job id for one control; marked it "in-progress" with ETA 2026-06-05.

People Ops: Thanks all. We'll post a short sprint wrap summary in #announcements after the window closes with high-level risk flags for exec review. If you're stuck, DM People Ops or drop into office hours. :raised_hands:
